title: Photo vote
description: Everyone picks a few photos of a bound folder; the cover shows the photos with the most votes. Each person has one choice of their own (at most `picks` photos), can change it and can change only theirs — the vote table's submitter field is filled by the service. The cover is computed by whoever looks, never written back.

votes.title: Votes
votes.description: A table with a text field marked submitter and a multi_select field `picks` (max_items = picks); `Prepare the ballot` fills its options from the photos

actions.title: Prepare the ballot
actions.description: An option of `picks` for every photo of the folder that has none yet (run again after adding photos)

catalog.description: Pick photos; the cover shows the favourites
